intro: Swish is where beauty meets practicality. With rounded edges and a flawless finish, it’s designed for homes where children play, families connect, and memories are made—all with enduring style​.

features.title: Granite-like MDF tabletop for a plush look
features.text: The MDF tabletop’s granite-like finish offers a sophisticated look that makes your dining area feel effortlessly plush.

features.title: Solid rubberwood legs for sturdiness
features.text: Count on lasting support. Solid rubberwood legs ensure durability and stability, perfect for everyday dining.

features.title: Rounded corners for safety
features.text: Built with your family in mind—rounded corners reduce sharp edges, making your dining area safer for kids.

features.title: Mahogany and walnut colour options for versatility
features.text: Style your space your way—available in mahogany and walnut, it complements a variety of interiors.

features.title: Sturdy tabletop for durability
features.text: Built with a robust 50 mm thick tabletop, ensuring strength you can rely on for daily use and special occasions.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
